To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
neural predictors can achieve high prediction accuracy in a small FPGA area, and they scale well with increasing table size in terms of prediction accuracy and speed.

1) a fast path-based organization of a neural branch predictor is possible on FPGAs; 2) the organization scales well in terms accuracy as the table size is increased; 3) the organization scales poorly in terms of FPGA logic area as the table size increases, but it scales well in terms FPGA speed; and 4) the organization scales in terms of speed as the table size decreases.
